name: lowbid-frontend-assets
description: Self-hosted frontend asset build for Lowbid: Tailwind CSS v3 + vendored Font Awesome, @stellar/freighter-api (UMD, global `freighterApi`) and @stellar/stellar-sdk (global `StellarSdk`). Nothing loads from a CDN; every output is committed.

scripts.vendor:fontawesome: rm -rf static/vendor/fontawesome && mkdir -p static/vendor/fontawesome && cp -R node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/css static/vendor/fontawesome/css && cp -R node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/webfonts static/vendor/fontawesome/webfonts
scripts.vendor: npm run vendor:fontawesome && npm run vendor:freighter && npm run vendor:stellar-sdk
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run vendor
